# Cases of the utilities in /bin, shared by test_msh.c (source and bytecode),
# the WASM harness and the Fosforo host: each runs in an empty directory of
# the home. See oracle.mjs for the fields and for checking them against the
# system's utilities.

# head
printf '1\n2\n3\n' | head -n 2	0	-	1\n2\n
printf 'a\nb' | head -n 5	0	-	a\nb
printf '' | head	0	-	
printf 'x\ny\n' > a; printf 'z\n' > b; head -n 1 a b	0	-	==> a <==\nx\n\n==> b <==\nz\n
head -n 1 missing	+	+	
printf 'x\n' > a; head -n 1 a missing	+	+	==> a <==\nx\n
head -n x	+	+	
printf 'abcdef' | head -c 3	0	-	abc
printf 'x\n' > ./-a; head -n 1 -- -a	0	-	x\n
printf 'x\n' > ./-a; head -n 1 ./-a	0	-	x\n
# tail
seq 1 20 | tail -n 3	0	-	18\n19\n20\n
seq 1 5 | tail -n +4	0	-	4\n5\n
printf 'a\nb' | tail -n 1	0	-	b
printf '' | tail	0	-	
tail missing	+	+	
printf 'abcdef' | tail -c 2	0	-	ef
# wc
# rocchetto: wc writes POSIX's "%d %d %d", without the padding of BSD's
!printf 'a b\nc\n' | wc	0	-	2 3 6\n
# rocchetto: wc writes POSIX's "%d %d %d", without the padding of BSD's
!printf 'a\nb' | wc -l	0	-	1\n
# rocchetto: wc writes POSIX's "%d %d %d", without the padding of BSD's
!printf '' | wc -c	0	-	0\n
# rocchetto: as above, with POSIX's "%d %s"
!printf 'a\n' > a; printf 'bb\n' > b; wc -c a b	0	-	2 a\n3 b\n5 total\n
wc missing	+	+	
# rocchetto: wc writes POSIX's "%d %d %d", without the padding of BSD's
!printf 'a b' | wc -w	0	-	2\n
# grep
printf 'ab\ncd\n' | grep b	0	-	ab\n
printf 'ab\ncd\n' | grep x	1	-	
printf 'ab\ncd\n' | grep -v b	0	-	cd\n
printf 'ab\ncd\n' | grep -c .	0	-	2\n
printf 'Ab\n' | grep -i ab	0	-	Ab\n
printf 'ab\n' > a; printf 'xb\n' > b; grep b a b	0	-	a:ab\nb:xb\n
printf 'ab\n' > a; grep -l b a missing	2	+	a\n
grep -q b missing	2	+	
printf 'a1\nb\n' | grep -E 'a[0-9]+'	0	-	a1\n
printf 'a.b\naxb\n' | grep -F a.b	0	-	a.b\n
printf 'ab\na\n' | grep -x a	0	-	a\n
printf 'x\n-y\n' | grep -e -y	0	-	-y\n
printf 'ab' | grep b	0	-	ab\n
printf 'ab\ncd\n' | grep -n d	0	-	2:cd\n
printf '' | grep a	1	-	
grep	2	+	
# sort
printf 'b\na\nc\n' | sort	0	-	a\nb\nc\n
printf '10\n9\n2\n' | sort -n	0	-	2\n9\n10\n
printf 'b\na\nb\n' | sort -u	0	-	a\nb\n
printf 'a 2\nb 1\n' | sort -k 2	0	-	b 1\na 2\n
printf 'b:1\na:2\n' | sort -t : -k 2 -n	0	-	b:1\na:2\n
printf 'b\na\n' | sort -r	0	-	b\na\n
printf 'x' | sort	0	-	x\n
printf '' | sort	0	-	
printf 'b\n' > a; printf 'a\n' > b; sort a b	0	-	a\nb\n
printf 'a\nb\n' | sort -c	0	-	
printf 'b\na\n' | sort -c	1	+	
sort missing	2	+	
# uniq
printf 'a\na\nb\n' | uniq	0	-	a\nb\n
printf 'a\na\nb\n' | uniq -c	0	-	   2 a\n   1 b\n
printf 'a\na\nb\n' | uniq -d	0	-	a\n
printf 'a\na\nb\n' | uniq -u	0	-	b\n
printf 'x a\ny a\n' | uniq -f 1	0	-	x a\n
printf '' | uniq	0	-	
printf 'a\na' | uniq	0	-	a\n
uniq missing	+	+	
# cut
printf 'a:b:c\n' | cut -d : -f 2	0	-	b\n
printf 'a:b:c\n' | cut -d : -f 1,3	0	-	a:c\n
printf 'abcdef\n' | cut -c 2-4	0	-	bcd\n
printf 'a:b\nnodelim\n' | cut -d : -f 2 -s	0	-	b\n
printf 'abc' | cut -c 1	0	-	a\n
cut -c 1 missing	+	+	
cut	+	+	
# tr
printf 'hello\n' | tr a-z A-Z	0	-	HELLO\n
printf 'aabbcc\n' | tr -s ab	0	-	abcc\n
printf 'a1b2\n' | tr -d 0-9	0	-	ab\n
printf 'abc\n' | tr -c a x	0	-	axxx
printf 'a b\n' | tr '[:space:]' '_'	0	-	a_b_
printf '' | tr a b	0	-	
tr	+	+	
# cmp
printf 'abc' > a; printf 'abd' > b; cmp a b	1	-	a b differ: char 3, line 1\n
printf 'abc' > a; printf 'abc' > b; cmp a b	0	-	
printf 'ab' > a; printf 'abc' > b; cmp a b	1	+	
printf 'abc' > a; printf 'abd' > b; cmp -s a b	1	-	
printf 'abc' > a; cmp a missing	2	+	
printf 'abc' > a; printf 'abd' > b; cmp -l a b	1	-	     3 143 144\n
# sed
printf 'abc\n' | sed 's/b/X/'	0	-	aXc\n
printf 'aaa\n' | sed 's/a/b/g'	0	-	bbb\n
printf '1\n2\n3\n' | sed -n 2p	0	-	2\n
printf '1\n2\n3\n' | sed 2d	0	-	1\n3\n
printf '1\n2\n3\n' | sed '$!d'	0	-	3\n
printf 'ab\n' | sed 's/\(a\)\(b\)/\2\1/'	0	-	ba\n
printf 'ab\n' | sed -E 's/(a)(b)/\2\1/'	0	-	ba\n
printf '1\n2\n3\n4\n' | sed -n '/2/,/3/p'	0	-	2\n3\n
printf 'a\n' | sed 'y/a/b/'	0	-	b\n
printf 'a\nb\n' | sed -n '$='	0	-	2\n
printf 'a\nb\n' | sed 'N;s/\n/,/'	0	-	a,b\n
printf 'x\n' | sed -e 's/x/y/' -e 's/y/z/'	0	-	z\n
printf '' | sed p	0	-	
printf 'a\n' | sed k	+	+	
sed p missing	+	+	
# rocchetto: -i takes no suffix (BSD's wants one); a file that is not there is said,
# and not made
!sed -i s/a/b/ missing	+	+	
!sed -i s/a/b/ missing; test -e missing; echo $?	0	+	1\n
# rocchetto: a script is needed (BSD's sed says nothing and gives 0)
!sed	+	+	
# nl fold paste comm join expand unexpand
printf 'a\n\nb\n' | nl	0	-	     1\ta\n      \t\n     2\tb\n
printf 'a\nb\n' | nl -ba -w 2 -s ' '	0	-	 1 a\n 2 b\n
printf 'abcdefgh\n' | fold -w 3	0	-	abc\ndef\ngh\n
printf 'ab cd ef\n' | fold -s -w 4	0	-	ab \ncd \nef\n
printf '1\n2\n' > a; printf 'x\ny\n' > b; paste a b	0	-	1\tx\n2\ty\n
printf '1\n2\n' > a; printf 'x\ny\n' > b; paste -d , a b	0	-	1,x\n2,y\n
printf '1\n2\n' > a; paste -s a	0	-	1\t2\n
printf 'a\nb\nc\n' > a; printf 'b\nc\nd\n' > b; comm a b	0	-	a\n\t\tb\n\t\tc\n\td\n
printf 'a\nb\nc\n' > a; printf 'b\nc\nd\n' > b; comm -12 a b	0	-	b\nc\n
printf '1 a\n2 b\n' > a; printf '1 x\n3 y\n' > b; join a b	0	-	1 a x\n
printf '1 a\n2 b\n' > a; printf '1 x\n3 y\n' > b; join -a 1 a b	0	-	1 a x\n2 b\n
printf 'a\tb\n' | expand	0	-	a       b\n
printf 'a\tb\n' | expand -t 4	0	-	a   b\n
printf '        a\n' | unexpand	0	-	\ta\n
printf 'a       b\n' | unexpand -a	0	-	a\tb\n
# od cksum basename dirname seq
printf 'ab' | od -c	0	-	0000000    a   b                                                        \n0000002\n
printf 'ab' | od -t x1	0	-	0000000    61  62                                                        \n0000002\n
# rocchetto: the offset after the last byte, 0000000 for nothing, as POSIX and GNU's
# write it (BSD's writes nothing)
!printf '' | od -c	0	-	0000000\n
printf 'abc' | cksum	0	-	1219131554 3\n
printf '' | cksum	0	-	4294967295 0\n
printf 'x' > a; cksum a	0	-	12738659 1 a\n
basename /a/b/c.txt .txt	0	-	c\n
basename /	0	-	/\n
basename a//	0	-	a\n
dirname /a/b	0	-	/a\n
dirname a	0	-	.\n
dirname /	0	-	/\n
seq 3	0	-	1\n2\n3\n
seq 2 2 7	0	-	2\n4\n6\n
# rocchetto: seq is not POSIX; a step of 1 never comes down to a smaller last, as
# in GNU's (BSD's counts down)
!seq 3 1	0	-	
# split tsort pr tee expr date
seq 5 > f; split -l 2 f; cat xaa xab xac	0	-	1\n2\n3\n4\n5\n
seq 5 | split -l 2 - p; cat pab	0	-	3\n4\n
seq 5 > f; split -l 0 f	+	+	
printf 'a b\nb c\n' | tsort	0	-	a\nb\nc\n
printf 'a b c\n' | tsort	+	+	
seq 7 | pr -t -3 -w 20	0	-	1      4      7\n2      5\n3      6\n
seq 3 | pr -t -n -d	0	-	    1\t1\n\n    2\t2\n\n    3\t3\n\n
printf 'a\n' | tee f; cat f	0	-	a\na\n
printf 'a\n' | tee nodir/f	+	+	a\n
expr 1 + 2	0	-	3\n
expr 7 / 2	0	-	3\n
expr abc : 'a\(.\)'	0	-	b\n
expr 0 \| ''	1	-	0\n
expr a + 1	2	+	
date -u -r 0 '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'	0	-	1970-01-01 00:00:00\n
# xargs find mkdir rmdir rm mv cp
printf 'a b\nc\n' | xargs echo	0	-	a b c\n
printf 'a b c\n' | xargs -n 1 echo	0	-	a\nb\nc\n
printf 'a\nb\n' | xargs -I % echo x%y	0	-	xay\nxby\n
printf '' | xargs echo	0	-	
mkdir d; touch d/a d/b; find d | sort	0	-	d\nd/a\nd/b\n
mkdir d; touch d/a d/b; find d -name a	0	-	d/a\n
find missing	+	+	
mkdir -p d/e; find d -type d | sort	0	-	d\nd/e\n
mkdir x; mkdir x	+	+	
rmdir missing	+	+	
printf a > f; mv f g; cat g	0	-	a
printf a > f; cp f g; cat f g	0	-	aa
rm missing	+	+	
rm -f missing	0	-	
mkdir d; printf a > d/f; rm -r d; find . | sort	0	-	.\n
# ranges joined, blanks, tabs and backspaces: cut, fold, expand, unexpand
printf 'abcdef\n' | cut -c 4-,1-2	0	-	abdef\n
printf 'abcdef\n' | cut -c 3-5,1-4	0	-	abcde\n
printf 'abcdef\n' | cut -b 5-,-2	0	-	abef\n
printf 'a:b:c:d\n' | cut -d : -f 3-,1	0	-	a:c:d\n
printf 'a:b:c:d\n' | cut -d : -f 2,2,9	0	-	b\n
printf 'ab\n' | cut -c 5-	0	-	\n
printf 'ab cd ef gh\n' | fold -s -w 5	0	-	ab \ncd \nef gh\n
printf 'abcdefgh ij\n' | fold -s -w 4	0	-	abcd\nefgh\n ij\n
printf 'a\tb\n' | fold -w 4	0	-	a\n\t\nb\n
printf 'ab\bcdef\n' | fold -w 3	0	-	ab\x08cd\nef\n
printf 'abc\n\nde\n' | fold -w 2	0	-	ab\nc\n\nde\n
printf 'ab\bc\td\n' | expand	0	-	ab\x08c      d\n
printf 'a\tb\tc\n' | expand -t 2,5	0	-	a b  c\n
printf '    a  b\n' | unexpand -a	0	-	    a  b\n
printf '\t  x\n' | unexpand	0	-	\t  x\n
printf '        a       b\n' | unexpand	0	-	\ta       b\n
printf 'x       y\n' | unexpand -t 4	0	-	x\t\ty\n

# an option not there is refused, never passed over
head -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
tail -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
wc -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
grep -% x < /dev/null	2	+	
sort -% x < /dev/null	2	+	
uniq -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
cut -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
tr -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
cmp -% x < /dev/null	2	+	
sed -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
nl -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
fold -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
paste -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
comm -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
join -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
expand -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
unexpand -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
od -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
cksum -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
split -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
tsort -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
pr -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
tee -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
xargs -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
mkdir -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
rmdir -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
rm -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
mv -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
cp -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
touch -% x < /dev/null	+	+	
# rocchetto: POSIX gives basename and dirname no options, so -% is the path
# (BSD's take -a and -s, and refuse the rest)
!basename -% x < /dev/null	0	-	-%\n
!dirname -% x < /dev/null	0	-	.\n
# ls
printf x > b; printf y > a; mkdir d; ls	0	-	a\nb\nd\n
printf x > b; printf y > a; ls -r	0	-	b\na\n
printf x > .h; printf y > a; ls -A	0	-	.h\na\n
printf x > .h; ls -a	0	-	.\n..\n.h\n
mkdir d; printf x > f; ls -F	0	-	d/\nf\n
mkdir d; printf x > f; ls -p	0	-	d/\nf\n
mkdir d; printf x > d/f; ls -d d	0	-	d\n
mkdir d; printf x > d/f; ls d	0	-	f\n
mkdir d e; printf x > d/f; ls d e	0	-	d:\nf\n\ne:\n
printf x > f; mkdir d; printf y > d/g; ls f d	0	-	f\n\nd:\ng\n
printf xxx > a; printf x > b; ls -S	0	-	a\nb\n
printf x > a; printf xxx > b; ls -Sr	0	-	a\nb\n
mkdir d; printf x > d/f; ls -R	0	-	d\n\n./d:\nf\n
printf x > a; printf y > b; ls -m	0	-	a, b\n
printf x > a; printf y > b; ls -1	0	-	a\nb\n
ls missing	+	+	
printf x > a; ls a missing	+	+	a\n
ls -j	+	+
